user.title: Cloud Inverter Setup
user.description: Choose where Home Assistant should read inverter data.

select_inverter.title: Select Your Inverter
select_inverter.description:
Multiple inverters found. Please select which one to monitor.

Note: The ID shown (e.g., ABCDE123456789) matches the serial number printed on your inverter device.

local.title: Local Analyzer
local.description: Run the SolarMax local analyzer on your LAN first. Enter its base URL, for example http://192.168.50.20:8765. Home Assistant reads its cached data; it does not poll the inverter directly.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to Cloud Inverter API. Please check your internet connection and try again.
error.invalid_auth: Invalid username or password. Please check your credentials and try again.
error.no_inverters: No inverters found in your account. Please add an inverter to your CloudInverter.net account first.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Please check the logs and try again.
error.invalid_url: Enter the analyzer base URL with http:// or https:// and an explicit port, without /api/ha.
error.invalid_response: The URL did not return a SolarMax analyzer configuration.
error.cannot_connect_local: Cannot reach the local analyzer. Check its URL, LAN connection, and port 8765.
